notes.title: Our New Otome Turn Based RPG is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We’re thrilled to announce that our upcoming game, Love in an Enchanted Realm, is in development! We’ve been hard at work, and we can’t wait for you to check it out.

🌟 Find out more on the Steam page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3187800/Love_in_an_Enchanted_Realm/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=rubydreams]Love in an Enchanted Realm[/url]

Your support means everything to us, and we look forward to having you with us every step of the way!

notes.title: Veilcrest: Trial of the Arcane Kickstarter is Live!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We’re excited to announce that the Kickstarter campaign for our enchanting otome game, "Veilcrest: Trial of the Arcane" is now live! Dive into a magical world of romance, mystery, and adventure.

🌟 Support us on Kickstarter: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/repulse/veilcrest-trial-of-the-arcane?ref=2gxmbh]Veilcrest: Trial of the Arcane[/url]

Join us on this journey and help bring "Veilcrest: Trial of the Arcane" to life. Your support means the world to us!

Thank you!
